nodes.text: Two ewes and the dog. A pack that sat in the veil forty years and never came down for a sheep. That is Sorrel's count. Torsten has his on a slate up the trail, wolves seven, and I want it nought. Get his count from his mouth, then go into the veil and make it nought at the den. I will say the cost, since the sergeant will. Alder shuts his yard to you for it and says the wolves were the stand's business, and the sergeant writes a nought under his seven and does not thank you.
The den is in the veil west of the trail, past the picket. Follow the wolves home.
Then mind the trail at dusk.
